===Road to Endor===
====Hoth====
Ackbar was present when [[Beilert Valance]] offered a [[datacard]] that held the plans to a [[Deflector shield generator|shield generator]].<ref name="Two Sides to Every Sortie">{{StoryCite|story=Two Sides to Every Sortie|book=Empire Ascendant 1}}</ref> Although Admiral Ackbar was not present at the [[Battle of Hoth]], he did receive a call to come and assist with the evacuation. However, there was not enough time to scramble the rebel fleet. The evacuation was completed in a matter of hours,<ref name="The Rebel Files" /> but the Alliance suffered major losses.<ref name="Episode V">{{Film|V}}</ref>

After the battle, Ackbar implemented a new hyperspace jump schedule for the fleet: Jump coordinates would be transmitted from the ''[[Home One]]'' to all of the nearby ships in the fleet, with the coordinates then being given to other outposts and vessels. As a safeguard, Ackbar had every gunner in the fleet fire on any craft that came out of hyperspace on an incorrect reversion vector.<ref name="The Rebel Files" /> When X-wing pilots [[Wedge Antilles]] and [[Wes Janson]] rendezvoused with the ''Home One'', Antilles speculated that the reason for the lateness of Luke Skywalker could be because of Ackbar having high-security rebels take extra hyperspace jumps.<ref name="Rendezvous Point">{{StoryCite|story=Rendezvous Point (short story)|book=From a Certain Point of View: The Empire Strikes Back}}</ref>

====Battle at Ab Dalis====
After the Rebel Alliance managed to escape the [[Battle of Ab Dalis]], Ackbar, Mothma, and the rest of the [[Eleventh Division]] grouped up with the [[Fourth Division|Fourth]] and [[Seventh Division]]s. They were rescued by the Fourth Division's [[Starlight Squadron]] and Commander Skywalker and given a new security transmission code based on the lost language of [[Trawak]].<ref name="Star Wars 15">[[Star Wars (2020) 15|''Star Wars'' (2020) 15]]</ref>

Sometime later, Ackbar and Mothma briefed on various updates since Hoth. Ackbar stated that while the fleet had been diminished, there was now time to address secondary goals. The first goal was to reestablish a supply chain, with Captain [[Amilyn Holdo]] negotiating a deal with the crime families until the [[Syndicate War]] broke out.<ref name="SW19">[[Star Wars (2020) 19|''Star Wars'' (2020) 19]]</ref> 

====Unity Day attack====
{{Quote|Congratulations on a successful mission, General Organa.|Ackbar to Organa|<ref name="SW26">[[Star Wars (2020) 26|''Star Wars'' (2020) 26]]</ref>}}
[[File:RebelCommand-2020StarWars26.png|220px|thumb|right|Ackbar congratulated Organa on a successful attack ]]
After the Alliance's successful [[Unity Day attack|attack]] during [[Empire Day]] on [[Bar'leth]], Admiral Ackbar congratulated Organa on the mission during a meeting. Organa appreciated Ackbar's willingness to risk rebel people and ships on missions that took place deep into the Empire's territory. During the meeting, Ackbar agreed with General [[Hera Syndulla]]'s point that the rebel fleet lost many of its connections while trying to reform after Hoth. He once again stated the Rebel Alliance needed to re-establish contacts with its intelligence assets in order to rebuild their supply lines. Ackbar recommended establishing a base so that the rebel ships could go through repairs. He then recommended the rebels continue their strategic attacks, making it public in order to show the galaxy that the Empire was vulnerable.<ref name="SW26" />

Sometime after, Ackbar took part in a briefing led by Captain Syndulla addressing recent potential intelligence the Rebellion had gathered.<ref name="SW27">[[Star Wars (2020) 27|''Star Wars'' (2020) 27]]</ref>

====Second Death Star revealed====
{{Quote|She undoubtedly has agents in the Alliance as well. We should--|Ackbar interrupted by Mothma|<ref name="SW28">[[Star Wars (2020) 28|''Star Wars'' (2020) 28]]</ref>}}
[[File:LukeRevealsDeathStarII-2020StarWars28.png|175px|thumb|left|Rebel command was shocked by the revelation of a second Death Star]]
Skywalker undertook a [[Mission to Coruscant|mission]] to [[Coruscant]] to rescue [[Crimson Dawn]] [[Sleeper Agent|spies]] who defected from the Empire. Upon his return, he held a briefing with rebel command on highly important intel. When asked where Organa was, Ackbar told him that she was in another sector, due to recent rebel efforts to not gather too much of the fleet at once. Skywalker's revelation that the spies were from Crimson Dawn, a worried Ackbar believed that Dawn also had spies in the Rebel Alliance. Skywalker continued and revealed the Empire was constructing a [[DS-2 Death Star II Mobile Battle Station|second Death Star]], shocking rebel command.<ref name="SW28" />

Later on, Ackbar briefed Alliance members on an [[Assault on Coruscant|aerial assault]] on the Imperial [[capital]] [[Coruscant]].<ref name="SW36">[[Star Wars (2020) 36|''Star Wars'' (2020) 36]]</ref>

====Chaos on the ''Home One''====
{{Quote|I can see that commander! Run diagnostics... get slicers up here to break into the systems... and get this ship back under our control!|Admiral Ackbar to a rebel commander|<ref name="SW37" />}}
The [[Scourge]], a malevolent droid, possessed [[Petyr]], a [[Crusaders|crusader]] of the [[Second Revelation]] droid freedom group. Petyr then secretly boarded the ''Home One'', and possessed C-3PO, while Ackbar and other rebel leaders discussed how to take down the second Death Star.<ref name="Dark Droids 1">[[Dark Droids 1|''Dark Droids'' 1]]</ref>

All of a sudden, the [[AJ^6 cyborg construct|cybernectic implants]] in the [[cyborg]] [[Lobot]] malfunctioned, causing the ''Home One'' to go into battle alert. The [[deflector shield|shield]] batteries were activated, confusing Ackbar as he gave no such order. Ackbar ordered all rebel personnel that the [[cruiser]] had gone into red-alert status and to report to their battle stations immediately. As chaos ensued on the ''Home One'', a [[Unidentified rebel commander|rebel commander]] reported to Admiral Ackbar that the ship was acting like it was in battle but there was no enemy detected. Ackbar ordered the commander to run diagnostics and break into the systems in order to get the ''Home One'' under control.<ref name="SW37">[[Star Wars (2020) 37|''Star Wars'' (2020) 37]]</ref>

Rebel personnel then reported the main [[turbolaser]] batteries were warming up with no activation codes. Ackbar ordered the rebel fleet to take evasive maneuvers, as the ''Home One'' began to open fire. At the same time, rebel member [[Landonis Balthazar Calrissian|Lando Calrissian]] discovered Lobot was at fault for the chaos and was forced to destroy his implants in the process. Ackbar then ordered a full investigation into who could've been responsible.<ref name="SW37" />

====Siege of Inyusu Tor====
[[File:Inyusu_Tor_Siege.jpg|thumb|right|240px|Inyusu Tor came under siege.]]
In [[3 ABY]],<ref name="Sullust">''[[Battlefront: Twilight Company]]'' establishes that the [[Siege of Inyusu Tor]] takes place twenty-two [[Standard year|years]] after the [[Clone Wars]], which [[Mission to Mustafar|ended]] in [[19 BBY]] according to ''[[Star Wars: Galactic Atlas]]''. The siege must have therefore occurred in [[3 ABY]].</ref> Alliance Intelligence introduced [[Operation Ringbreaker]], a series of coordinated assaults which had the goal of shutting down the naval shipyards at the [[Kuat Drive Yards]]. Once its defenses were stretched to the tipping point, naval and infantry forces would attack. General Madine sent the Phase 1 overview of Ringbreaker, which detailed how the [[61st Mobile Infantry]] would secure multiple targets.<ref name="The Rebel Files" />

The Operation was planned to culminate with the sabotage of the Kuat Drive Yards. However, the operation came to a halt at the [[Siege of Inyusu Tor]] when Imperial resistance was more than the rebel forces could handle. Ackbar said<ref name="The Rebel Files" /> in 34 ABY<ref name="Date TRF" /> that Operation Ringbreaker was brilliantly planned but was brought low by undetectable circumstances. Commander Mothma said that another attempt to take Kuat would not be attempted.<ref name="The Rebel Files" />

====Trial of Lando Calrissian====
{{Quote|By the tide...Mon Mothma's been kidnapped!|Ackbar shocked by Mothma's kidnapping|<ref name="SW44" />}}
[[File:LandoTrial-2020StarWars44.png|275px|thumb|left|Admiral Ackbar was a magistrate for Calrissian's trial.]]
Between [[3 ABY]] and [[4 ABY]],<ref name="Date SW44">The events of [[Star Wars (2020)|''Star Wars'']] take place after the [[Escape from Cloud City]] and before the [[Rescue of Han Solo]], which are dated to [[3 ABY]] and [[4 ABY]], respectively, by ''[[Star Wars: Galactic Atlas]]''.</ref> Lando Calrissian stood trial in accordance with the [[Corellian code of military justice]] for [[treason]] against the Rebellion. Ackbar, along with Mothma and General Madine, served as [[magistrate]]s for the trial. Admiral Ackbar and Madine argued pre-trial that Calrissian should be executed for his crimes, but Mothma and Organa advised that it would harm rebel morale. However during the trial, Mothma who was participating via [[hologram]] was [[Kidnapping of Mon Mothma|kidnapped]] by [[Scarabi]] mercenaries, shocking Ackbar.<ref name="SW44">[[Star Wars (2020) 44|''Star Wars'' (2020) 44]]</ref>

Admiral Ackbar then activated [[Tactical Plan Eighteen]], which ordered the Alliance Fleet to disperse to random locations in the event their location had been compromised. Calrissian's [[lawyer]], [[Salli Georgio]] argued that the case must be dismissed due to Mothma being incapacitated, but Ackbar and the other magistrates disagreed, allowing for the trial to continue. Shortly after, he was present with the rest of Rebel High Command to receive a ransom from the Scarabi for 200 million [[Galactic Credit Standard|credits]], due within a day before the mercenaries could consider third parties. Ackbar then proclaimed that the Alliance would be bankrupt if they paid.<ref name="SW45">[[Star Wars (2020) 45|''Star Wars'' (2020) 45]]</ref>

[[File:LandoVerdict-2020StarWars47.png|250px|thumb|right|Ackbar and the magistrates find Calrissian guilty.]]
Later on, Ackbar and the rebel commanders analyzed potential Scarabi safehouses brought forward by Chewbacca, in order to [[Mission to rescue Mothma|rescue]] Mothma. Unfortunately for Ackbar, he was having difficulty understanding the [[Wookiee]]'s native [[language]], [[Shyriiwook]]. Dispatching the pathfinders, the rebels were able to rescue Mothma and Calrissian's trial continued.<ref name="SW46">[[Star Wars (2020) 46|''Star Wars'' (2020) 46]]</ref> 

[[Lobot]] testified in Calrissian's defense, describing him as loyal but Ackbar argued that the trial was taking place for the opposite reason. Lobot responded to him by providing evidence of how Calrissian had been loyal to him. After more testimonies and then closing statements, the magistrates discussed for five minutes before delivering a guilty verdict. Ackbar ordered Calrissian to pay the Rebel Alliance 250 million credits in compensation for treason, but the debt was suspended pending the end of the war and could be decreased based on his contributions to the Rebellion.<ref name="SW47">[[Star Wars (2020) 47|''Star Wars'' (2020) 47]]</ref>

====Preparing to strike====
{{Quote|The Empire has begun construction on a second Death Star|Admiral Ackbar briefs rebel leaders|<ref name="Moving Target">''[[Moving Target: A Princess Leia Adventure]]''</ref>}}
[[File:Death_Star_II_revealed.png|thumb|left|250px|Admiral Ackbar solemnly reveals the second Death Star.]]
Around [[4 ABY]],<ref name="HC 53">{{HelmetCollectionCite|53|Highlights of the Saga}}</ref> many rebel leaders rendezvoused at the planet [[Zastiga]]. During a top clearance meeting, a hologram was shown of an incomplete Death Star. Many present, including Princess Leia, were confused, assuming that it was the [[DS-1 Orbital Battle Station|Death Star]] from the Battle of Yavin. Ackbar then revealed that the Empire had begun construction on a second Death Star, with a larger diameter and many advanced specifications such as an advanced [[superlaser]]. The other leaders at the meeting began to discuss what the Alliance's next move would be, and how they would go about destroying it. General [[Airen Cracken]] and Ackbar explained that the flaw that had allowed the first Death Star to be destroyed at the hand of Skywalker would have been removed. He and Mon Mothma agreed that the Rebellion would have to make their attack before the [[battle station]]s completion.<ref name="Moving Target" />

[[File:Leia_on_the_Shieldmaiden.png|thumb|right|275px|Operation Yellow Moon (pictured) was a success.]]
The next day, the leaders returned to the briefing room, many of whom were exhausted. When Mothma motioned for him to begin, Ackbar once again brought up the holo of the second Death Star. He explained that the Death Star would be vulnerable as long as its [[Reactor|main reactor]] was exposed. When Admiral [[Massa]] dejectedly said that the entire rebel fleet would not be enough to defeat the [[Imperial Navy|Imperial Fleet]], Ackbar fired back, explaining that they would not be able to win the battle ship to ship, but rather by creating [[time]] for their starfighters. Ackbar also revealed that they had learned that the station was protected by an energy field generated from the surface of a nearby moon. Madine's [[Rebel Alliance Special Forces|commandos]] would steal an [[Lambda-class T-4a shuttle|Imperial shuttle]], get to the moon, and knock out the generator.<ref name="Moving Target" />

One [[Unidentified Mon Calamari admiral|admiral]] pointed out that it would be difficult for the fleet to assemble without the Empire noticing. Ackbar explained,<ref name="Moving Target" /> as he had previously told Mon Mothma, that Sullust was the only realistic fleet staging area if the Alliance was to take advantage of the [[Sanctuary Pipeline]],<ref name="The Rebel Files" /> which was a closely guarded Imperial secret until rebel agents were able to discover it. The fleet would gather there, the commando team would go and bring down the shield, and the fleet would follow, traveling down the Sanctuary Pipeline. Princess Leia then offered a [[Operation Yellow Moon|strategy]] to distract the Empire from discovering what they were up to: Leia would lead a fake recruiting run with a supposed rendezvous point, while the real fleet gathered at Sullust. Leia's suggestion of Nien Nunb to be her pilot on the mission was supported by Ackbar. Organa assumed that since Ackbar did not object to her plan, he approved of it. Although the plan was not immediately vetoed, it did take some more consideration from Mothma.<ref name="Moving Target" />

When Madine volunteered himself for the mission, Ackbar shot this down, saying that Madine was required to stay to help plan for Endor.<ref name="Moving Target" /> Ackbar also mentioned that since the Rebellion had already struck Sullust during [[Operation Ringbreaker]], it would be believable that they would do so again. He promised Mothma that after the Battle of Endor, the fleet would return to liberate Sullust.<ref name="The Rebel Files" /> In 34 ABY,<ref name="Date TRF" /> Ackbar said that this was accomplished, but months after Endor as opposed to the planned days.<ref name="The Rebel Files" />

[[File:General_Lando.png|thumb|left|230px|Admiral Ackbar recruited Lando Calrissian (left) to lead the starfighter attack]]
During [[Commander]] [[Iden Versio]]'s [[Escape from the Invincible Faith|escape from the ''Invincible Faith'']], she snuck past a room where Ackbar was debriefing rebel personnel to join the rest of the Rebel fleet who were to join together at [[Sullust]] to launch a surprise attack on the second Death Star.<ref name="Battlefront II">''[[Star Wars Battlefront II]]''</ref> When Mothma asked who Ackbar had chosen to lead the starfighter attack on the second Death Star, she suggested Luke Skywalker. Ackbar, on the recommendations of the Sullustan [[Nien Nunb]] and Ensign Deltura, suggested Lando Calrissian. In order to convince Calrissian, Ackbar first tried appealing to his honor.<ref name="The Rebel Files" /> Despite Calrissian having developed a deep belief in the rebel cause,<ref name="SW45" /> Ackbar failed to appeal to Calrissian through that approach, so he went straight to [[Currency|money]].<ref name="The Rebel Files" />

====Assassination attempt on Mothma====
{{Quote|Well, I need you-- I need you to use everything you've learned and collected to find out who is out to kill Mon Mothma. But you cannot do this alone.|Admiral Ackbar dispatches Kes Dameron and his wife|<ref name="The Rebellion 1" />}}
[[File:Ackbar-ROTJTheRebellion1.png|255px|thumb|right|Ackbar ordered Dameron to prevent Mothma's assassination attempt]]
Six [[Standard day|days]] before the [[Battle of Endor]], Admiral Ackbar received a transmission from [[Buccel Trune]] who learned of a [[Attempt to assassinate Mon Mothma|plot]] to [[assassin]]ate Mon Mothma. Skeptical at first, Ackbar questioned Trune on the legitimacy of the intelligence, but Trune reassured him the threat was very serious.<ref name="The Rebellion 1">[[Return of the Jedi – The Rebellion 1|''Return of the Jedi – The Rebellion'' 1]]</ref>

Afterwards, Ackbar met with Mothma, who was unconcerned with the plot. She believed the Rebel Alliance had to press forward with the planned attack on the second Death Star and not waste any resources on uncovering a potential false plot. But the Admiral argued the Rebellion could protect her and push forward at the same time. He believed the safety of all rebel leaders was a top priority if the Rebellion was to become a republic. Meanwhile, Mothma noted his opinion she still believed the plot to be false, with little reliable evidence to back up the intel. Ackbar believed the intel was similar to a double-edge [[sword]], in that while the finer details were scant the broad details remained true. Even though he continued to plead his case, Mothma refused to reallocate any resources to her protection and didn't want to hear any protest from the Admiral.<ref name="The Rebellion 1" />

Shortly afterwards, Admiral Ackbar went behind Mothma's back and secretly met with [[Kes Dameron]] via hologram to discuss protecting the rebel leader. Dameron understood Mothma's point and questioned why Ackbar called him in the first place. Ackbar, stressed from the recent news, explained to Dameron that the Rebel Alliance was on the cusp of something big and they would need everything to go right in order to achieve success. He believed the assassination plot happened at the worst possible time for the galaxy. Admiral Ackbar then ordered Dameron, alongside his wife, [[Shara Bey]] to locate and prevent the assassination.<ref name="The Rebellion 1" />

Ackbar's suspicions and the intelligence would be proven true when the Empire did attempt to assassinate Mothma but the Rebel Alliance pathfinders were able to foil the plan.<ref name="The Rebellion 1" /> 

====Battle of Endor====
{{Quote|It's a trap!|Admiral Ackbar|audio=ItsATrap-ROTJ.flac|<ref name="Episode VI" />}}
[[File:AdmiralAck.png|thumb|220x220px|Admiral Ackbar during the Battle of Endor.]]
Ackbar was one of the commanders of the Battle of Endor. At the pre-mission briefing, Gial told the plan of how the Rebels would attack the Death Star. He explained that a ground team led by General Han Solo would go to the surface of the forest moon of [[Endor]] and take out the shield generator and that a fighter squadron led by General Lando Calrissian would then enter the battle station's superstructure and take it out from the inside.<ref name="Episode VI" /> After the briefing, Ackbar pulled aside [[engineer]] [[Evans Basch]] to apologize for being unable to find the [[refugee]], [[Tobie]]. He then told Basch that he had given the Alliance hope and that he must seize it.<ref name="Hyperspace Stories 12">[[Hyperspace Stories 12|''Hyperspace Stories'' 12]]</ref>

He commanded the fleet from the bridge of his ship, ''Home One''. Once the battle commenced, however, between the fleet's sensors being jammed and an Imperial fleet cutting off their escape, Ackbar realized that they had been led into a trap—the Empire was leading them to their demise. Ackbar was reluctant to continue the battle after the Rebels saw that the Death Star's superlaser was operational. However, Calrissian convinced him otherwise. Once Han Solo's squad took out the shield generator, Ackbar's fleet held off the rest of the Imperial forces while Calrissian and his fighters, along with [[Wedge Antilles]], flew inside the Death Star to take it out. Ackbar especially told his forces to concentrate their firepower on the ''[[Executor]]'', which was ultimately destroyed by an A-wing.<ref name="Episode VI" /> Ackbar was devastated by the loss of life that took place at the battle.<ref name="Ackbar DB" />

In the aftermath of the battle, Ackbar addressed the Alliance informing them that the time to celebrate had come and that Skywalker had reported the deaths of Palpatine and Vader. However, he warned that the time to rest had not yet arrived, saying the Empire's weapon may have been destroyed but the Empire itself lived on and stated the oppressive hands of the Empire closed around the throats of good, free-thinking people across the galaxy. He ended by saying that their fight would continue because, while the rebellion was over, the war was just beginning.<ref name="Aftermath" />

===New Republic===
====Rebellion on Akiva====
{{Quote|But we also must recognize the Empire's ability to play the long game. Our victory over Endor was fortunate, but the Empire orchestrated that trap with great patience.|Admiral Ackbar debating strategy with fellow New Republic leaders|<ref name="Aftermath" />}}
[[File:Shattered_Empire_1_textless_cover.jpg|thumb|left|250px|The great victory at Endor did not mark an end to the Galactic Civil War.]]
Despite the Empire's defeat at Endor, they continued to fight, launching [[Operation: Cinder]], a contingency plan issued posthumously by the Emperor. Over three months after the Battle of Endor,<ref name="SE4">[[Shattered Empire 4|''Shattered Empire'' 4]]</ref> the Alliance officially reorganized into a [[New Republic]], continuing to defend against the Imperial attacks. As Admiral, Ackbar commanded the [[New Republic Defense Fleet]] in its campaign against the remnants of the Empire. In his free time, Ackbar honed his mind by practicing with his [[kar-shak]] against simulated [[stormtrooper]]s.<ref name="Aftermath" /> He stated in a public [[HoloNet]] address that he knew the fighting had not yet come to a close.<ref name="HC 1" />

Admiral Ackbar's military campaign against the Empire was aided by a mysterious Imperial informant known as [[Gallius Rax|the Operator]], who leaked intelligence about Imperial military movements. While Ackbar was practicing with his kar-shak, he was visited by [[Ensign]] [[Ardin Deltura|Deltura]] who informed the Admiral that Captain Wedge Antilles had ceased communicating with them after his scouting mission to [[Raydonia]]. Ackbar ordered Deltura to send scouts to five nearby planets including [[Mustafar]], [[Geonosis]], [[Dermos]], [[Akiva]], and [[Tatooine]]. As a precaution, Ackbar ordered Deltura to dispatch two scouts to Akiva.<ref name="Aftermath" />

Deltura then informed him that they had received new information from the Operator. When Ackbar expressed surprise that an Ensign was privy to classified information, Deltura reassured him that Commander [[Kyrsta Agate]] had given him clearance. Deltura dispatched two [[RZ-1 A-wing interceptor|A-wing scout ships]] to Akiva but the ships were shot down by an Imperial Star Destroyer commanded by [[Admiral]] [[Rae Sloane]]. The Empire was hosting an [[Akiva Summit|emergency summit]] on the planet and Antilles had been captured by Imperial forces there.<ref name="Aftermath" />

Following the downing of the scout ships, Admiral Ackbar corresponded with several New Republic leaders and officials via [[hologram]] including Commander Agate Captain [[Saff Melor]], General [[Crix Madine]], and the newly-appointed [[Chancellor (New Republic)|Chancellor]] [[Mon Mothma]]. When Agate suggested they could trust the Operator, Ackbar warned that the Battle of Endor showed that the Empire had the ability to play the long game. When Melor advocated sending in a fleet to Akiva, Mothma urged caution to avoid creating the impression that the New Republic were invaders.<ref name="Aftermath" />

While Melor and Mothma debated the merits of aiding a strategically marginal planet like Akiva, Ackbar sided with the Chancellor and urged his comrades to be ready for Imperial traps. He then asked General Madine whether he could send a small strike team of [[New Republic Special Forces]] soldiers to investigate Akiva. Madine replied that was possible and Ackbar agreed to send a small scouting party to Akiva. This party was attacked by Imperial [[turbolaser]]s but one member [[Sergeant]] [[Jom Barell]] survived and played a role in the subsequent [[rebellion on Akiva]]. Ackbar was informed about the attack on Barell's scouting parting by Ensign Deltura and [[Science officer]] [[Niriian]].<ref name="Aftermath" />

[[File:Captain_Wedge_Antilles.jpg|thumb|right|300px|Wedge Antilles (pictured) was able to escape Imperial custody and alert Gial Ackbar to operations on Akiva.]]
During the summit, Antilles managed to break free for a short duration and send an emergency transmission to Ackbar, explaining the dire situation. In response, Ackbar prepared a small fleet to attack the Imperial presence on Akiva. Ackbar assigned Commander Agate to lead the attack on Akiva. Agate's small fleet destroyed two Star Destroyers while the New Republic pilot [[Norra Wexley]], her son [[Temmin Wexley|Temmin]] and a small rebel cell engineered an uprising that overwhelmed the meagre Imperial garrison and the collaborationist [[Satrapy of Myrra]]. Akiva became one of the first [[Outer Rim Territories|Outer Rim]] worlds to join the New Republic.<ref name="Aftermath" />

Admiral Ackbar's victory on Akiva was aided by the Operator, who sent intelligence about the position of the orbiting Star Destroyers. Despite finding his information useful, Ackbar did not fully trust the Operator,<ref name="Aftermath" /> who later turned out to be [[Fleet Admiral]] Gallius Rax.<ref name="Life Debt">''[[Aftermath: Life Debt]]''</ref> A month later, Ackbar presented a medal to Norra Wexley for her service in rescuing Antilles and helping the New Republic to liberate Akiva from the Empire.<ref name="Aftermath" />

====Commanding the starfleet====
{{Quote|Grand Admiral Ackbar.''"<br />"Grand admiral'' is an Imperial ranking. I, like you once did, identify as ''fleet admiral''—but you seem to have taken the title 'Grand Admiral' for yourself.|Grand Admiral Sloane and Admiral Ackbar exchange greetings|<ref name="Life Debt" />}}
[[5 ABY|One year]] after the Alliance's victory at Endor, the now-Fleet Admiral Ackbar led the New Republic Starfleet's campaign against the remnants of the Empire. While Ackbar's work took him into space, the Admiral still visited the New Republic capital of [[Chandrila]] to consult with Chancellor Mon Mothma and other leaders. On one such trip, Admiral Ackbar met with the New Republic starfighter pilot Norra Wexley at [[Skygarden]] above [[Hanna City]]. He ordered her to cease her mission to rescue the missing Han Solo and to resume her hunt for Imperial commissions. Norra refused to comply with this order and resigned her commission in the New Republic Navy. She, her son Temmin, the [[B1-series battle droid]] [[Mister Bones]], the former Imperial [[loyalty officer]] [[Sinjir Rath Velus]], the [[Zabrak]] [[bounty hunter]] [[Jas Emari]], and the New Republic soldier Jom Barell then embarked on a quest to find Solo.<ref name="Life Debt" />

During a later meeting with Chancellor Mothma and her advisers, Ackbar opined that the New Republic was not doing enough to win former Imperial systems to the New Republic. Mothma concurred and agreed to embark on a campaign to entice prospective members by giving them a place in the reconstituted [[New Republic Senate|Galactic Senate]]. Shortly later, Princess Leia entered the room and argued with Chancellor Mothma about not enough being done to aid the enslaved Wookiees of the planet [[Kashyyyk]]. Following a brief argument, a frustrated Leia stormed out of the meeting despite Ackbar's efforts to call out to her.<ref name="Life Debt" />

Later, Admiral Ackbar commanded a [[Defense of Kuat|successful campaign]] to capture the planet Kuat and the strategically important [[Kuat Drive Yards]]. The sector governor Moff [[Pollus Maksim]] and the guild head of Kuat Drive Yards capitulated. During the battle, Ackbar's forces lost fewer ships than their Imperial opponents. The loss of Kuat dealt a serious blow to the Galactic Empire.<ref name="Life Debt" />

[[File:WoTG-RaeSloane-Stormtroopers.png|thumb|left|250px|Grand Admiral Rae Sloane]]
Following the battle, Princess Leia contacted Admiral Ackbar by hologram to congratulate him for his role in securing the New Republic's victory. Shortly later, Chancellor Mon Mothma interrupted the conversation to inform her comrades that she had received communication from the Operator, who wanted to meet with the New Republic leadership. Ackbar ordered his comm officer [[Toktar]] to open the Old Alliance frequency Zeta Zeta Nine. The guest turned out to be [[Grand Admiral]] Sloane, the public face of the Galactic Empire. Despite Sloane's claims that she was the Operator, Ackbar did not believe her.<ref name="Life Debt" />

When Sloane addressed Ackbar as Grand Admiral, the Mon Calamari responded that Grand Admiral was an Imperial ranking and accused her of seizing the title for herself. Ackbar's colleague [[Commodore]] Agate soon joined the holo-conversation and accused Sloane of deceiving them. After exchanging some barbs, the New Republic commanders and Grand Admiral Sloane settled down to business. When Sloane revealed that she was interested in initiating [[Imperial–Republic peace talks|peace talks]] with the New Republic, Ackbar curled his chin tendrils to express skepticism. Nevertheless, he acceded to Chancellor Mothma's decision to raise the matter of the peace talks with the Galactic Senate.<ref name="Life Debt" />

In reality, the peace talks were a ruse for the Empire to stage an attack on Chandrila. Rax had manipulated Grand Admiral Sloane into approaching the New Republic for peace talks as part of his plot to use the liberated prisoners from [[Ashmead's Lock]] to assassinate the New Republic leadership. For this plot, Rax had inserted each of the prisoners with an inorganic bio-chip which allowed him to transmit signals into their brains. This turned the former prisoners into unwilling assassins.<ref name="Life Debt" />

Later, Admiral Ackbar and other New Republic officials greeted the liberated prisoners from Ashmead's Lock when they arrived at Hanna City [[Spaceport]]. After Han Solo and [[Chewbacca]] managed to stage a Wookiee uprising on Kashyyyk, Admiral Ackbar traveled on his ship ''Home One'' to support Princess Leia and Captain Wedge Antilles' [[Phantom Squadron]] in their attack on the orbiting Imperial Star Destroyers. After Solo and Chewbacca hijacked the ''[[Dominion]]'' and destroyed the Star Destroyer ''[[Vitiator]]'', the third Star Destroyer ''[[Neutralizer]]'' surrendered to Admiral Ackbar. Despite the liberation of Kashyyyk, the New Republic forces soon received news of the [[Attack on Chandrila|attack]] on Chandrila.<ref name="Life Debt" />

====Prelude to Jakku====
{{Quote|None of us are ready. No one can ever be truly ready for what war brings. The best we can do is meet it with our face forward and our hearts clear. You will do that. I know you will.|Admiral Ackbar encouraging Commodore Agate|<ref name="Empire's End">''[[Aftermath: Empire's End]]''</ref>}}
[[File:Jakku_view.jpg|thumb|right|300px|The planet Jakku (pictured) was set to hold the final showdown between the Galactic Empire and New Republic.]]
Following the events on Chandrila, Rax took control of the Imperial fleets and ordered them to assemble above the planet [[Jakku]] for a showdown with the New Republic.<ref name="Life Debt" /> Several months later, Temmin and Rath Velus discovered that the Empire had relocated to Jakku. They informed Chancellor Mothma and Princess Leia but the information was leaked to the press by Chancellor Mothma's rival Senator [[Tolwar Wartol]]. After Wartol publicly attacked Mothma's leadership, Admiral Ackbar reassured Chancellor Mothma that she had made the right decision to withhold the information since she had only obtained it less than a [[standard day]]. After Mon Mothma indicated she would issue a statement to the press, Admiral Ackbar added that he would send a scout ship and [[probe droid]]s to Jakku to investigate.<ref name="Empire's End" />

Admiral Ackbar dispatched Ensign Deltura on the scout ship ''[[Oculus]]'' and several probe droids to investigate. After the scouting team confirmed that most of the [[Imperial Remnants|Imperial remnants]] had relocated to Jakku, Chancellor Mothma convened an emergency session of the Galactic Senate and urged the Senate to support her resolution to send military forces to the planet. However, the resolution failed by five votes. Following the vote, Admiral Ackbar visited Chancellor Mothma to inform her that the vote had failed. He remarked that this meant that the fleet would not depart for Jakku and that the Empire would remain there.<ref name="Empire's End" />

After Rath Velus managed to convince the five senators to change their votes, the New Republic was able to send its military forces to Jakku. Prior to the battle, Admiral Ackbar managed to convince Commodore Kyrsta Agate to return to her command board the [[Starhawk-class battleship|''Starhawk''-class battleship]] ''[[Concord]]''. Agate had been disfigured during the Attack on Chandrila and had been despondent. He also visited Agate aboard her flagship and praised her as one of his best and brightest officers. When Agate remarked that some of the light had gone out of her, Ackbar complimented her for recognizing the burden of war and for not giving in to anger.<ref name="Empire's End" />

When Agate expressed doubts about her ability to captain the ''Concord'', Ackbar reassured her that none of them were truly ready for what. He added that the best they could was to meet it with forward faces and clear hearts. Ackbar also recognized that the Empire was aware of their presence and added that he would be ready for a full-scale fleet battle. When Agate opined that Jakku could be a ruse, Ackbar reassured her that they would be ready. When Agate asked if they were going to win, Ackbar responded that it would be an honor to fight alongside them regardless of whether it was their final battle or the first of many to come. The two then parted company and assumed their battle positions.<ref name="Empire's End" />

====Defeating the Empire====
{{Quote|Soldiers and pilots of the New Republic! The dreadnought ''Ravager'' is down—it falls to Jakku! Beware debris and take cover!|Admiral Ackbar during the Battle of Jakku|<ref name="Empire's End" />}}
[[File:FrontLines-AckbarJakku.png|thumb|left|230px|Admiral Gial Ackbar, as he appeared at the Battle of Jakku]]
During the [[Battle of Jakku]], Admiral Ackbar commanded the New Republic fleet. Despite outnumbering the Empire, the New Republic fleet was unable to break through the Imperial defensive lines. The Imperial Star Destroyers had formed a defensive perimeter around the [[Super Star Destroyer]] ''[[Ravager]]'', the Imperial flagship. During the battle, the Star Destroyers would periodically open the flank to allow the ''Ravager'' to fire its turbolasers and torpedoes at the New Republic fleet. As a result, several New Republic warships and starfighters were destroyed.<ref name="Empire's End" />

While commanding the space battle, Ackbar also liaised with General [[Tyben]], who was commanding the ground assault via hologram from Chandrila. When Tyben opined that he should be on Jakku with [[Lieutenant General]] [[Brockway]], Ackbar countered that they needed to maintain reserve forces on Chandrila and the new capital [[Nakadia]] in case Jakku turned out to be a ruse. Ackbar then witnessed the Star Destroyer ''[[Punishment]]'' break formation with the Imperial fleet and ram the Starhawk ''[[Amity]]'', destroying both ships. Realizing that Agate's ship ''Concord'' lay in the gap, Ackbar opened the channel to contact Commodore Agate.<ref name="Empire's End" />

Believing they were in danger, Admiral Ackbar ordered the Commodore and her crew to abandon the ship. Agate ordered her crew to comply but stayed behind. She realized that the ''Punishment''{{'s}} destruction had created a gap that would allow her ship to attack the ''Ravager''. As the ''Concord'' exchanged fire with the ''Ravager'', Ackbar ordered her to abandon her ship. However, Agate convinced Ackbar to send starfighters and [[CR90 corvette]]s to attack the Super Star Destroyer's exposed flank engines. Despite some arguing, Ackbar finally accepted Agate's sacrifice and prayed that the Force would be with them all.<ref name="Empire's End" />

[[File:Battle_of_Jakku.jpg|thumb|right|250px|The ''Ravager is destroyed'']]
The ''Concord'' was crippled by the ''Ravager'' and plummeted towards Jakku's surface. However, Agate then activated her ship's powerful [[tractor beam]] and proceeded to drag the Super Star Destroyer down with her. As the two ships descended into Jakku's orbit, Ackbar grabbed the [[intercom]] and warned all New Republic soldiers and pilots that the ''Ravager'' had been downed and to take cover and beware of falling debris. While Ackbar's crew cheered behind him, the Admiral did not cheer but prayed for the Force to protect those below and to accept Agate as one of its own.<ref name="Empire's End" />

The downing of the ''Ravager'' turned the tide of the Battle of Jakku in the New Republic's favor. Meanwhile, Grand Admiral Sloane joined forces with her New Republic adversaries [[Brentin Lore Wexley]] and Norra Wexley to stop Gallius Rax, the [[Counselor to the Empire]], from detonating Jakku and the orbiting Imperial and New Republic fleets.<ref name="Empire's End" /> Following the battle, the New Republic and Galactic Empire signed the [[Galactic Concordance]] which ended the Galactic Civil War. The Galactic Concordance demilitarized and imposed harsh sanctions on the remnants of the Empire. With the war's end, the New Republic turned its attention to restructuring the galactic order.<ref name="TFA Visual" /> After the Empire's final defeat,<ref name="HC 20" /> Ackbar retired to his homeworld of Mon Cala.<ref name="TFA Visual" /> In [[16 ABY]],<ref name="Aftab Birthday">''[[The Art of Star Wars: The Rise of Skywalker]]'' states that Aftab Ackbar is nineteen [[Standard year|years]] old during the events of {{Film|IX}}, which ''[[Star Wars: Timelines]]'' dates to [[35 ABY]].</ref> Ackbar [[Reproduction|fathered]] a [[Youngling|son]], [[Aftab Ackbar|Aftab]], although he would only see his son once after his spawning.<ref name="Allegiance 2">[[Allegiance 2|''Allegiance'' 2]]</ref>

====Proposing a new X-wing====
Ackbar realized that the [[T-70 X-wing starfighter]] was overdue for technical and mechanical upgrades having been in service of the New Republic Defense Fleet for more than two [[Standard decade|decades]].<ref name="ROSOWM">''[[Rebel Starfighters Owners' Workshop Manual]]'' states that the T-70 X-wing had been used by the New Republic Defense Fleet for over two decades this places it at least 24 ABY because ''[[Star Wars: The Rise of Skywalker: The Visual Dictionary]]'' states it was formed thirty years before the [[Hosnian Cataclysm]].</ref> He proposed that the New Republic Navy should commission the [[Incom-FreiTek Corporation]] to design a prototype for a new model. The result was the next generation of X-wing, the [[T-85 X-wing starfighter]].<ref name="RSOWM">''[[Rebel Starfighters Owners' Workshop Manual]]''</ref>

Ackbar was disappointed that Calrissian did not remain in service<ref name="The Rebel Files" /> after Calrissian returned to Cloud City after the Galactic Civil War.<ref name="SW 3">[[Star Wars (2025) 3|''Star Wars'' (2025) 3]]</ref> Following the revelations of Organa's parentage as the birth daughter of Darth Vader, Ackbar along with several other rebel veterans sent messages of support to the embattled New Republic senator. He and several rebel veterans and New Republic personnel later attended a meeting on [[Hosnian Prime]] where Leia formally established the [[Resistance]], a paramilitary group dedicated to protecting the New Republic.<ref name="Bloodline">[[Bloodline (novel)|''Bloodline'']]</ref>

===The Resistance===
====Early Resistance days====
While Ackbar was away with the Resistance, his son Aftab, studied every battle and victory of his father.<ref name="Allegiance 2" /> Eventually, after Ackbar had been with the Resistance for a short time, Aftab begged him to come back into retirement.<ref name="TROS VD" /> 

====Imprisonment and escape====
[[File:Gial_Ackbar_Resistance_Base.jpg|thumb|left|250px|Ackbar in the Resistance base on D'Qar]]
At some point after his recruitment, Ackbar was captured by the [[First Order]]<ref name="The Phantom Limb" /> and held hostage on the [[Subjugator (Resurgent-class)|''Subjugator'']], a [[Resurgent-class Star Destroyer|''Resurgent''-class Star Destroyer]].<ref name="Flight Log">''[[Poe Dameron: Flight Log]]''</ref> Afraid that the First Order would execute him, the Resistance assembled a team led by Captain [[Hoff (Resistance captain)|Hoff]] to locate Ackbar. Hoff's team eventually captured a First Order droid named [[0-MR1|O-MR1]], who they believed knew the location of Ackbar. On their way back to the [[Resistance base]], the team's [[Sterdic Star|ship]] [[Mission to Taul|crashed]] on [[Taul]], with the only survivors being a group of droids, including O-MR1, led by [[C-3PO]]. The droids began following a signal they received from a First Order vessel, but on their way, they were attacked by [[spice spider]]s and later by [[can-cell]], resulting in the destruction of all of the droids, except C-3PO and O-MR1. The two droids found the vessel, but before they could contact the Resistance, it began [[Acid rain|raining acid]]. They took cover under another ship's wing, but knew that if they didn't contact help soon, the control panel would melt. O-MR1, who now saw C-3PO as his friend, told 3PO the location of Ackbar, before sacrificing himself to contact [[Poe Dameron]] for help. After the [[Battle of Takodana]], Ackbar was asked to question [[Finn]] on everything he knew about [[Starkiller Base]].<ref name="TFA novel">[[Star Wars: The Force Awakens (novelization)|''Star Wars: The Force Awakens'' novelization]]</ref> The Resistance then began to plan their [[Battle of Starkiller Base|attack]] on the base after that they would be the next target. ====Death====
{{Quote|It's been an honor serving with you all.|Gial Ackbar's final words|<ref name="TLJ Adaption 2">[[The Last Jedi Adaptation 2|''The Last Jedi Adaptation'' 2]]</ref>}}
[[File:Ackbar_on_the_Raddus.jpg|thumb|250px|Ackbar in the ''Raddus''<nowiki>'</nowiki> bridge]]
Following the Battle of Starkiller Base, Ackbar and the other Resistance members learned the First Order regrouped and were preparing for an [[Battle of D'Qar|attack]] on their base. Admiral Statura questioned how the First Order could've regrouped so quickly, but Ackbar didn't think it mattered.<ref name="Poe Dameron 28">[[Poe Dameron 28|''Poe Dameron'' 28]]</ref> He then aided the rest of the Resistance in the evacuation of the base. When the First Order caught the Resistance during their evacuation, Admiral Ackbar confirmed to the rest of the Resistance crew onboard the [[MC85 Star Cruiser]], the [[Raddus (MC85 Star Cruiser)|''Raddus'']] that the First Order had a [[flotilla]] of ships. He also stated that the [[Mandator IV-class Siege Dreadnought|First Order dreadnought]] had more firepower than a dozen destroyers and was designed for large-scale planetary assault. The admiral felt that they had no time left to spare and must jump to hyperspace now, but General Leia Organa insisted they buy as much time for the remaining Resistance forces to evacuate as they could.<ref name="The Last Jedi Adaptation 1">[[The Last Jedi Adaptation 1|''The Last Jedi Adaptation'' 1]]</ref>

After destroying the dreadnought, he commanded the fleet,<ref name="Bio Gallery">{{Databank|url=admiral-ackbar-biography-gallery|title=Admiral Ackbar Biography Gallery}} Slide #17</ref> and ordered it to jump to hyperspace and escape the First Order. However, unknown to the Resistance, the First Order had developed technology that allowed them to track ships through hyperspace. Ackbar ordered the ship to be turned around and to concentrate power on the rear shields. The First Order fleet pursued the Resistance and initiated an attack on the bridge of the Raddus. Kylo Ren and his two other wingmates destroyed the hangar of the Raddus and made their way to the primary bridge of the MC85 Star Cruiser, where the majority of Resistance command was present. Though Ren could not bring himself to fire on the bridge after sensing his mother's presence there, his wingmates, [[Poldin LeHuse]] and a second [[TIE series|TIE fighter]] had no such qualms and fired missiles upon the primary bridge.<ref name="Episode VIII">{{Film|VIII}}</ref>

[[File:ItsAWrap-TLJ.png|thumb|left|300px|Ackbar is killed in the destruction of the ''Raddus''<nowiki>'</nowiki> bridge]]
As one of Ackbar's Mon Calamari aides notified him of the inbound torpedoes, the gruff admiral looked to the crew of the bridge, embracing the fact that his fate had been sealed and there was no chance for escape, and declared his respect for them in the face of [[death]] before the missiles struck the adjacent viewport.<ref name="TLJ Adaption 2" /> In a huge explosion, Ackbar, the most esteemed military commander of his generation, was gone.<ref name="TLJ Junior Novel">''[[Star Wars: The Last Jedi: A Junior Novel]]''</ref> Only Organa survived the ordeal, calling on the Force to pull herself back to the bridge's exposed corridor to use as an [[airlock]]. Ackbar's death was later confirmed by Commander [[Larma D'Acy]] and Vice Admiral Holdo would take command as leader of the Resistance while Leia recovered from her vacuum exposure.<ref name="Episode VIII" />

===Legacy===
{{Quote|Admiral Ackbar was a hero until the very end. I only wish I could have brought his body home.''"<br />"''My father's remains may have been lost in the cold vacuum of space…but I believe his soul is here.|Leia Organa and Aftab Ackbar remembering Gial Ackbar|<ref name="Allegiance 2" />}}
[[File:MourningShrines-Allegiance2.png|thumb|left|175px|General Leia Organa and Aftab Ackbar pay their respects to the late admiral at the Mourning Shrines.]]
After the [[Battle of Crait]], Organa, Chewbacca, C-3PO, [[Rose Tico]], and [[Rey Skywalker|Rey]] traveled to Mon Cala in an [[Mission to the Outer Rim|attempt]] to gather potential allies for the Resistance. Once they arrived at Dac City, Organa met with Aftab, and she expressed her condolences for Gial's death, assuring Aftab that she was with Gial when he died and she wished she could have brought his corpse with her. Aftab replied that while his father's remains were lost in space, his soul was with them. They paid their respects at the [[Mourning Shrines]], where a statue of Ackbar was located.<ref name="Allegiance 2" /> Gial's death came as a deep loss to Aftab, who greatly admired his father. Aftab had implored his father to return to his retirement, and after his staying with the Resistance movement until the very end, Aftab had to live up to that legacy.<ref name="TROS VD" />

When Temmin and [[Karé Kun]] informed the retired Wedge Antilles and Norra Wexley about the Resistance losses since the Battle of [[Crait]], Antilles couldn't accept that Ackbar was gone after surviving the Battles of Endor and Jakku, having come to believe that the Mon Calamari admiral was going to [[Immortality|live forever]]. Likewise, Leia still remembered Ackbar not only as a leader but as a friend while she lamented the fact that he was gone, having known him for most of her life, which led Rey to express her condolences even though she never met him.<ref name="Resistance Reborn">''[[Resistance Reborn]]''</ref>

==Personality and traits==
===Overview===
{{Quote|I'm older. The reason I do this—stand here and take my kar-shak and continue to practice my kotas—is because I wish to stay sharp. And flexible. And ahead of my enemies. I know one day that I will fail at this, and we almost failed above Endor. We rushed in. Careless. It almost cost us everything.|Gial Ackbar was a seasoned military commander who kept his mind sharp and his body flexible|<ref name="Aftermath" />}}
[[File:SWCW_Ackbar.jpg|thumb|right|300px|A younger Ackbar during the Clone Wars, in which he fought alongside the Republic for the Mon Calamari monarchy.]]
Gial Ackbar was a seasoned and accomplished military commander<ref name="Aftermath" /> who served with the Mon Calamari Guard,<ref name="Water War" /> the Rebel Alliance, and its successors the New Republic<ref name="Aftermath" /> and Resistance.<ref name="TFA Visual" /> During the Clone Wars and his service to the Mon Calamari Guard, Ackbar was a mentor to the young Mon Calamari Prince Lee-Char and strove to protect the young prince's life. He believed that Lee-Char was the right claimant to the Mon Cala throne who had the interests of both the Mon Calamari and Quarren in mind. Ackbar taught the young Prince how to lead his people in combat. Despite his valor, Ackbar was also pragmatic enough to order a retreat when the Quarren and their Separatist allies unleashed cyborg Hydroids-Medusa.<ref name="Water War" />

After being driven into hiding, Ackbar advised Lee-Char and his Jedi and Republic allies to split up to avoid capture.<ref name="Gungan Attack" /> Despite his distrust of the Quarren for their connivance with the Separatists, Ackbar acceded to Lee-Char's plan to reunite the Mon Calamari and Quarren against the Separatist leader Karkarodon. Ackbar worked with his former Quarren adversary Nossor Ri to distribute weapons to the Mon Calamari and Republic captives and expel the Separatist invaders from Mon Cala.<ref name="Prisoners" />

By the time of the Galactic Civil War, Ackbar had become an Admiral in the Alliance Navy. He led the successful effort to evacuate the rebel base on Yavin IV following the Battle of Yavin.<ref name="Princess Leia 1" /> Ackbar was also a skilled tactician who devised the successful attack on the second Death Star using plans that had been stolen by [[Bothan]] spies. As a commander, Ackbar also knew how to delegate duties and assigned Han Solo to lead the strike team to deactivate the shield generator on Endor. During the Battle of Endor, Ackbar played an important role in saving many Alliance ships by sending them to attack the Imperial fleet in order to stop the second Death Star from firing on them.<ref name="Episode VI" />

[[File:ReturnoftheJedi-TheRebellion1-virgincover.jpg|thumb|left|250px|Ackbar helped lead the Alliance to victory in the war against the Galactic Empire.]]
Following the events on Endor, Admiral Ackbar commanded a string of New Republic victories which saw the taking of numerous worlds including Akiva, Kuat, and Kashyyyk. His skills and military victories won him the admiration of several of his Imperial foes including Grand Admiral Rae Sloane. While Ackbar found the Imperial informant Operator's information useful, he did not trust the mysterious leaker.<ref name="Life Debt" /> Despite his martial accomplishments, Ackbar still believed in the Force and often included it in his greetings.<ref name="Episode VI" />

Admiral Ackbar was suspicious of Grand Admiral Sloane's peace offer. His suspicions were confirmed when the peace offer was used by Fleet Admiral Gallius Rax to launch a sneak attack on the New Republic.<ref name="Life Debt" /> Ackbar encouraged Chancellor Mothma during her difficult times and reassured her that she had been wise not to immediately disclose information regarding Imperial forces on Jakku to the public. Ackbar also mentored Commodore Agate and encouraged her not to give up her command despite being disfigured during the Liberation Day attacks. He also cared for his crew but respected Agate's decision to sacrifice her life during the Battle of Jakku.<ref name="Empire's End" />

[[File:Admiral_Ackbar_TLJ.png|thumb|right|200px|Ackbar in the command chair aboard the ''Raddus''.]]
In the years after the Galactic Civil War, Ackbar maintained a deep respect for his former comrade Senator Leia Organa. He along with Mon Mothma, Han Solo, Chewbacca, [[Nien Nunb]], and C-3PO remained loyal to Leia despite revelations that she was the daughter of Darth Vader.<ref name="Bloodline" /> Ackbar was stirred by Organa's words<ref name="TROS VD" /> and also shared her view that the New Republic lacked the strength to safeguard the galaxy and joined the Resistance.<ref name="Bloodline" /> Resistance members such as Poe Dameron were honored to serve by him after hearing tales of his legendary military career.<ref name="TROS VD" />

At the time of Ackbar's death aboard the bridge of the Resistance's main cruiser, upon realizing that he would not survive the missile strike that would take his life, he demonstrated his courage, devotion to their rebellion and respect for his comrades as he took the opportunity to acknowledge them in his final words.<ref name="TLJ Adaption 2" /> Ackbar's loss was felt by many, including Leia, who regretted not being able to recover his corpse for a proper [[burial]] on his Mon Cala, remembering Ackbar as a hero until the very end.<ref name="Allegiance 2" />

A Mon Calamari [[Gender|male]],<ref name="Ackbar DB" /> Ackbar had [[Color|salmon]] skin and yellow-orange [[eye]]s.<ref name="Junior" /> He stood 1.8 [[meter]]s tall, or 5 [[Foot|feet]] and eleven inches.<ref name="TCW:CE" />

===Relationships===
====Aftab Ackbar====
{{Quote|Ah, my father had maybe seen me once since my spawning. His focus was elsewhere. But I knew him. I studied every battle--every victory.|Aftab Ackbar to Leia Organa|<ref name="Allegiance 2" />}}
Aftab Ackbar was the son of Admiral Ackbar,<ref name="Allegiance 2" /> who the admiral fathered at some point during his retirement.<ref name="TFA Visual" /> Aftab only saw his father once after his spawning where he begged him to return to retirement after he joined the Resistance.<ref name="TROS VD" /> Although he never saw his father after that he felt that he knew him through his service to the galaxy during the Galactic Civil War.<ref name="Allegiance 2" /> Aftab felt a great personal loss after the death of his father and took it upon himself to carry on his legacy.<ref name="TROS VD" />

====Leia Organa====
Leia Organa worked alongside Ackbar throughout the Galactic Civil War, with the New Republic and until his death with the Resistance. She was a friend of the Mon Calamari.<ref name="Resistance Reborn" /> Leia helped convince the Mon Calamari people to mutiny against the Galactic Empire and Ackbar helped Leia during the evacuation of the Yavin 4 base.<ref name="Star Wars 49" /><ref name="HC 1" /> After his death Leia visited the Mourning Shrines with Aftab to pay her respects to the late admiral, only wishing that she could have brought the body home.<ref name="Allegiance 2" />

====Lee-Char====
After ascending to the throne on Mon Cala, Prince Lee-Char was put under the protection of Captain Gial Ackbar who was captain of the Mon Cal Knights at the time. Ackbar was willing to break the tradition of the monarch of Mon Cala leading his troops into battle in order to protect the prince. When the Mon Calamari forces were forced to retreat Ackbar led the prince to the caves for protection.<ref name="Water War" /> Prince Lee-Char also looked up to Ackbar and asked him for guidance. When Ackbar was captured by the Separatists, Lee-Char broke into the prison in order to ask for advice from the captain and to tell him of the plan.<ref name="Prisoners" />

A few years later,<ref name="Occ" /> Ackbar was promoted to Chief of Security for King Lee-Char.<ref name="Dark Lord 13" />

==Skills and abilities==
{{Quote|Admiral Ackbar is gone? But he survived Endor. And Jakku. I thought...I thought he would live forever.|Wedge Antilles on Gial Ackbar|<ref name="Resistance Reborn" />}}
Though Admiral Ackbar was an accomplished military commander, he also kept his mind sharp and his body flexible by regularly practicing kar-shak against simulated stormtroopers.<ref name="Aftermath" /> He was not [[Force-sensitive]], but did possess above-average intelligence, diplomacy, strength, speed, and fighting abilities. Of those skills, his strongest was intelligence,<ref name="GF 2017">{{Topps|set=2017 Topps Star Wars Galactic Files Reborn|cardname=ROTJ-17 Admiral Ackbar|link=https://www.tcdb.com/ViewCard.cfm/sid/135181/cid/10118870/2017-Topps-Star-Wars-Galactic-Files:-Reborn-ROTJ-17-Admiral-Ackbar}}</ref> although he had difficulty understanding the Wookiee language, Shyriiwook.<ref name="SW46" /> He was also skilled in miltiary tactics, as well as armed and unarmed combat.<ref name="TCW:CE" />

==Equipment==
[[File:Admiral_Ackbar_2016_Regional_Championship_Prize.png|thumb|left|150px|Ackbar in his Mon Calamari fleet officer uniform]]
During the Clone Wars, when the Mon Calamari fought against the Separatist-aligned Quarren, Ackbar used a [[Battle baton|baton]] in combat.<ref name="Water War" />

During the Galactic Civil War, Admiral Ackbar wore a traditional naval [[Mon Calamari fleet officer uniform]] which had a [[utility belt]]. It was made of a fabric that retained moisture. The feature helped prevent his skin from drying out, which was a concern for a member of a species more used to being in water than a sterile starship.<ref name="HC 20">{{HelmetCollectionCite|20|Weapons & Uniforms}}</ref> He wore such a uniform on several occasions, including during the Battle of Endor.<ref name="Episode VI" /> Around the time prior to the Battle of Jakku, Ackbar practiced fighting with a kar-shak in case he ever needed to use it.<ref name="Aftermath" /> Ackbar would also arm himself with a [[blaster pistol]].<ref name="Ackbar DB" />

==Behind the scenes==
===Origins and development===
{{Quote|Having worked for Muppets I was used to having up to six people working together to create one character. I love watching a crew work seamlessly to bring an inanimate object to life.|Tim Rose on portraying Admiral Ackbar|<ref name="Rose interview">{{Blogspot|subdomain=starwarsinterviews1|url=2010/01/tim-rose-interview.html|name=Star Wars Interviews|text=Tim Rose interview|nolive=1}}</ref>}}
[[File:AckbarConceptNiloRodis-Jamero.jpg|thumb|right|220px|Concept art of Admiral Ackbar done by Nilo Rodis-Jamero]]
Admiral Ackbar was created for the [[1983]] film [[Star Wars: Episode VI Return of the Jedi|''Star Wars'': Episode VI ''Return of the Jedi'']], the final installment of the ''[[Star Wars]]'' [[original trilogy]].<ref name="Episode VI" /> Ackbar's first appearance, however, was in [[Archie Goodwin]]'s comic strip "[[It's a Trap]]," published in the [[Los Angeles Times Syndicate]] from [[November]] [[1982]] to [[January]] 1983.<ref name="It's a Trap">"[[It's a Trap]]"</ref> In ''Return of the Jedi'', Ackbar was portrayed by puppeteer [[Tim Rose]] and voiced by voice actor [[Erik Bauersfeld]] who also voiced [[Bib Fortuna]] in the film.<ref name="Episode VI" /> In the ''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars]]'' television series, Ackbar was voiced by [[Artt Butler]].<ref name="Ackbar in TCW">Truitt, Brian (September 8, 2011). "Admiral Ackbar stars in animated 'Star Wars'." [[Wikipedia:USA Today|''USA Today'']]. Retrieved September 14, 2011.</ref> Both Rose and Bauersfeld reprised Ackbar in the [[2015]] film [[Star Wars: Episode VII The Force Awakens|''Star Wars'': Episode VII ''The Force Awakens'']], the first installment of the [[sequel trilogy]], being Bauersfeld's final film role before his death in [[2016]].<ref name="TFA" /> In the [[2017]] sequel [[Star Wars: Episode VIII The Last Jedi|''Star Wars'': Episode VIII ''The Last Jedi'']], Rose portrayed the character once more, while voice actor [[Tom Kane]] voiced Ackbar.<ref name="Episode VIII" /> Kane had portrayed Ackbar in previous ''Star Wars'' media, such as ''[[LEGO Star Wars: Droid Tales]]''.<ref name="Gambit on Geonosis" /> In the [[Disney+]] miniseries ''[[Star Wars: Ahsoka]]'', Ackbar was portrayed by [[Elden Bennett]]<ref name="Getty">{{Getty|url=thewaltdisneystudios/allaccess#!asset/j9fm893gj2gvfbvbg6cx6q9|text=The Walt Disney Studios All Access - STC-FF-002596|date=2023-10-02}}</ref> in the [[Ahsoka Season 1|first season]] episode "[[Part Seven: Dreams and Madness]]."<ref name="A17">{{Ahsoka|Part Seven: Dreams and Madness}}</ref>

In the second draft of the script for ''Return of the Jedi'', Ackbar was slated to be a non-human with pale blue skin. The article "[[The Ultimate Return of the Jedi Insider's Guide]]," published in [[Star Wars Insider 67|''Star Wars Insider'' 67]], noted that as a connection with Grand Admiral [[Mitth'raw'nuruodo|Thrawn]].<ref name="Insider 67">{{InsiderCite|67|The Ultimate Return of the Jedi Insider's Guide|The Ultimate ''Return of the Jedi'' Insider's Guide}}</ref> During pre-production of the film, [[George Lucas]] allowed ''Return of the Jedi'' director [[Richard Marquand]] to pick from a selected 50 drawings for the look of aliens to play as Ackbar. Marquand went with a drawing by [[Nilo Rodis-Jamero]] which he called "Calamari man." The drawing had no backstory or personality to it.<ref name="The Making of Return of the Jedi">''[[The Making of Return of the Jedi]]''</ref> The [[Gran]] [[Ree-Yees]] was originally set to play the role of Admiral Ackbar, but when reviewing the sculpts of the creature, the filmmakers decided to go with the Mon Calamari admiral instead.<ref name="Much to Learn">{{SW|url=news/much-to-learn-you-still-have-10-things-you-might-not-know-about-mon-calamari|text=Much to Learn You Still Have: 10 Things You Might Not Know About Mon Calamari}}</ref>

[[File:Fishhead.jpg|thumb|left|250px|Tim Rose puts on Ackbar's mask during Episode VI's production]]
In ''Return of the Jedi'', Admiral Ackbar was realized as a combination slip-on mask and half-body puppet. All close-up shots involving dialogue used an extraordinarily detailed puppet controlled by Rose, who puppeteered [[Salacious B. Crumb]] too.<ref name="DB">{{DB|character|admiralackbar|Ackbar, Admiral}}</ref> From [[Wikipedia:Jim Henson|Jim Henson]], Rose was loaned to [[Lucasfilm]] during Episode VI's production and was assigned to puppeteer Crumb and [[Sy Snootles]]. Rose asked visual effects supervisor [[Phil Tippett]], however, if he could also perform Ackbar. Rose was familiar with the controls and had already designed much of the puppet by that point, but the only thing that he knew about Ackbar was that he was a background character who was to appear later after the appearance of both Snootles and Crumb at [[Boba Fett's Palace|Jabba's Palace]], wearing Ackbar's mask during scenes that didn't require a puppet too.<ref name="Rose interview" /> Bauersfeld was cast to voice both Ackbar and [[Bib Fortuna]] by [[Ben Burtt]] and [[George Lucas]] after they asked him to do some voices for them while producing a radio drama with [[Randy Thom]], yet he didn't actually meet any of the cast members—though he received a nice letter from Rose. An easy job, Bauersfeld recorded both Ackbar's and Fortuna's voices in such an hour with Burtt.<ref name="Bauersfeld interview">{{WebCite|url=http://www.starwarsinterviews.com/original-trilogy/episode-vi-return-of-the-jedi/erik-bauersfeld-voice-of-admiral-ackbar|text=Eric Bauersfeld interview|work=[http://starwarsinterviews1.blogspot.com Starwarsinterviews1 Blogspot]|archivedate=20170320011816|nolive=1}}</ref> Due to uncertainty inherent in giving key expository dialogue to Ackbar as he was a fish-faced puppet, some backup scenes were shot featuring Crix Madine filling Ackbar's role during the Battle of Endor, but Ackbar's shots ultimately remained.<ref name="MadineDB">{{DB|character|generalcrixmadine|Madine, General Crix}}</ref>

While the character's surname was created by George Lucas during the production of ''Jedi'' after seeing the mask in the creature shop,<ref name="Galaxy 2">{{GalaxyCite|3|Star FX|Star FX: Creature Creations}}</ref> Ackbar's first name wasn't coined until the release of the [[Star Wars Legends|''Star Wars'' Legends]] reference book ''[[The Essential Guide to Warfare]]'', written by both [[Jason Fry]] and [[Paul R. Urquhart]] and released on [[April 3]], [[2012]], which established Ackbar's first name as "Gial."<ref name="TEGtW">''[[The Essential Guide to Warfare]]''</ref> The name was upheld in [[canon]] with the release of the reference book ''[[Star Wars: Absolutely Everything You Need to Know]]'', published on [[September 4]], 2015.<ref name="Everything" />

[[File:AckbarCereal.jpg|thumb|right|140px|Admiral Ackbar Cereal from the first ''Robot Chicken: Star Wars'' special.]]
During the development of the [[2005]] film [[Star Wars: Episode III Revenge of the Sith|''Star Wars'': Episode III ''Revenge of the Sith'']], the final installment of the [[prequel trilogy]], Lucas was so impressed with the animatronic capabilities of the Mon Calamari Meena Tills that he briefly considered replacing Ackbar's footage from Episode VI with Tills's mask, as Lucas always felt that the result of Ackber's puppetry technology was a compromise in spite of achieving the latest technology available in 1983. Nevertheless, the original footage was ultimately left unaltered.<ref name="Meena DB">{{DB|character|meenatills|Tills, Meena}}</ref> Ackbar was present in the original script for the 2016 [[Star Wars Anthology Series|''Star Wars'' Anthology]] film ''[[Rogue One: A Star Wars Story]]'', appearing to lead the rebel fleet during the [[Battle of Scarif]] in the film's climax, but after [[J.J. Abrams]] featured Ackbar in Episode VII, the part of Admiral Raddus was created to replace Ackbar as the crew believed that Ackbar shouldn't appear in two films released together so closely.<ref name="Entertainment Weekly">{{WebCite|url=http://ew.com/movies/2017/03/24/rogue-one-revisions-tie-fighter-scene-deleted-planet-killed-cameos|text=''Rogue One'' revisions: The TIE fighter scene, a deleted planet, and killed cameos|author=Anthony Breznican|date=2017-03-24|quote="I always loved Admiral Ackbar. I wanted to have him in there, but J.J. Abrams got to him first. We didn't want to use him again after The Force Awakens. So Ackbar became Admiral Raddus. You will see those little evolutions."|archivedate=20171203190336}}</ref>

===Non-canon history===
Ackbar has appeared in several forms of non-[[canon]] media:

====''LEGO Star Wars: The Freemaker Adventures''====
[[File:AckbarKyber.png|thumb|left|275px|Admiral Ackbar made appearances in ''LEGO Star Wars: The Freemaker Adventures''.]]
Admiral Ackbar made several appearances during ''[[LEGO Star Wars: The Freemaker Adventures]]'', primarily on ''Home One'' while the [[Freemakers/LEGO|Freemakers]] were stationed there. In the episode [[Return of the Kyber Saber]], Ackbar appears in a [[hologram]] asking for the Empire's 27th "Most Wanted" fugitive, [[Rowan Freemaker/LEGO|Rowan Freemaker]]. Ackbar then recruits the Freemakers into the Rebel Alliance with a job offer.<ref name="Return of the Kyber Saber">{{FreemakerAdventures|Return of the Kyber Saber}}</ref> In the episode "[[Home One (episode)|Home One]]," Ackbar met with the Freemaker family in person for the first time. He then sends them on a mission to find a Type A vector coil promising them a permanent job with the Alliance if they succeed.<ref name="Home One (episode)">{{FreemakerAdventures|Home One (episode)}}</ref> During the episode "[[Thrown Into Battle]]," Admiral Ackbar sounded an alarm over the comms, alerting the rebels that the Empire had found the Fleet. Ackbar ordered the Rebel starfighters to scramble. Ackbar awarded a medal to [[R0-GR/LEGO|Roger]] for his services during the [[Skirmish with an Imperial Star Destroyer|battle]].<ref name="Thrown Into Battle">{{FreemakerAdventures|Thrown Into Battle}}</ref>

In "[[Zander Freemaker, Superstar Pilot Guy!]]," [[Zander Freemaker]] tried to convince Admiral Ackbar to let him fly a fighter. Ackbar told him to ask [[Lieutenant]] [[Colvett Valeria]]. Ackbar then alerted the fleet of an Imperial attack. When the battle was finished, Ackbar and his crew looked on in horror as Zander's starfighter was destroyed.<ref name="Zander Freemaker, Superstar Pilot Guy!">{{FreemakerAdventures|Zander Freemaker, Superstar Pilot Guy!}}</ref> In the episode "[[Beware, the Gamorrean Flu!]]," The Freemaker family pay the admiral a visit. Ackbar tells them that two rebel agents are trapped behind an Imperial blockade. The Freemakers volunteer for the [[Mission to rescue Lando Calrissian and Chewbacca|mission]]. After the mission, Lando Calrissian, one of the rebel agents trapped, thanked Ackbar for recruiting them.<ref name="Beware, The Gamorrean Flu!">{{FreemakerAdventures|Beware, the Gamorrean Flu!}}</ref>

[[File:Alliance_leadership_Freemakers.jpg|thumb|right|275px|Gial Ackbar with other rebel leaders]]
At the beginning of the episode "[[Trouble on Tibalt]]," Ackbar ordered the rebel personnel on ''Home One'' to report to their battle stations, as the Empire had located the fleet. The rebel starfighters managed to punch a hole in the Imperial offensive, and Ackbar ordered the Rebel Fleet to escape to hyperspace.<ref name="Trouble on Tibalt">{{FreemakerAdventures|Trouble on Tibalt}}</ref> During a rebel briefing in the episode "[[The Tower of Alistan Nor]]," [[Kordi Freemaker/LEGO|Kordi Freemaker]] proposed five-minute showers in order to conserve water. Everyone was surprised, and turned to look at Ackbar, a water planet native, who questioned why everyone was looking at him.<ref name="The Tower of Alistan Nor">{{FreemakerAdventures|The Tower of Alistan Nor}}</ref>

In the episode "[[The Storms of Taul]]," Ackbar received a transmission from [[Major]] [[Bren Derlin]] which stated that he was heading to the junk fields of the planet [[Taul]]. Ackbar sent the Freemakers to rescue him. After their successful [[Rescue of Bren Derlin|rescue]], Ackbar congratulated them via hologram.<ref name="The Storms of Taul">{{FreemakerAdventures|The Storms of Taul}}</ref> Ackbar made an appearance at the end of the episode "[[Return to the Wheel]]" via a hologram congratulating them on their [[Mission to obtain an energy matrix activator|mission]], but he got worried when they told him that Darth Vader was looking for [[kyber crystal]]s. Ackbar then told his fellow Rebel leaders to summon the [[Bothan]]s to find out if the Empire was building a second Death Star.<ref name="Return to the Wheel">{{FreemakerAdventures|Return to the Wheel}}</ref> In the episode "[[Flight of the Arrowhead]]" Ackbar contacted [[Quarrie]] during a [[Mission to save the Rebel Fleet|battle]], asking if the [[Arrowhead (Freemakers)|Arrowhead]] was ready. However, Quarrie's answer did not reassure him and Ackbar was left in disbelief. The Arrowhead was eventually fixed and saved the Rebel fleet; Ackbar gave the Freemaker family medals and promotions for their bravery in battle.<ref name="Flight of the Arrowhead">{{FreemakerAdventures|Flight of the Arrowhead}}</ref>

[[File:AckbarplusSyndulla.png|thumb|left|275px|Ackbar in "Escape from Coruscant"]]
During their celebration after [[Skirmish on Kashyyyk (Freemakers)|defeating]] the Empire on [[Kashyyyk]] in the episode "[[A Perilous Rescue]]," Ackbar and the other Rebel leaders congratulated the Freemakers on their hard-earned victory. Later on aboard ''Home One'' Admiral Ackbar briefs the rebels about their upcoming attack on [[Dubrillion]]. He also agreed with Kordi's plan and had her brief Lieutenant Valeria, calling Kordi "commander" for the first time.<ref name="A Perilous Rescue">{{FreemakerAdventures|A Perilous Rescue}}</ref> In the episode [[Escape from Coruscant]] Zander and Kordi come running to the rebel leaders in order to tell them what had happen to Rowen, but Ackbar has trouble hearing them before Roger clarifies for him. He also denied them permission to rescue him. He is interrupted by a rebel officer who tells him that the Empire is building a second Death Star. He instantly ran off saying they had to stop it. Later on, Ackbar watched from the command bridge as the Freemakers defied his orders and went to go [[Rescue of Rowan Freemaker|rescue]] Rowan.<ref name="Escape from Coruscant">{{FreemakerAdventures|Escape from Coruscant}}</ref>

====''LEGO Star Wars: Droid Tales''====
[[File:AckbarDroidTales.png|thumb|right|250px|Admiral Ackbar excitedly plans the Battle of Endor]]
Right after the Battle of Endor, R2-D2 and C-3PO planned to go with Admiral Ackbar to liberate the lost battle droids of [[Mandalore]] with Admiral Ackbar in the episode "[[Exit from Endor]]."After the story finished a mysterious figure kidnapped R2 and took off in Ackbar's ''Daisy Mae''. This prompts 3PO and Ackbar to take another ship to find the kidnapper.<ref name="Exit from Endor">{{DroidTales|Exit from Endor}}</ref> In the episode [[Crisis on Coruscant]], Ackbar and C-3PO traveled to [[Coruscant]] to find RD-D2 and the ''Daisy Mae''. Ackbar located his ship by smelling it underneath a pile of [[paper]]. After 3PO finished his story, Ackbar had to deal with a tow truck towing the Daisy Mae away while 3PO continued his journey to find R2.<ref name="Crisis on Coruscant">{{DroidTales|Crisis on Coruscant}}</ref>

In the episode "[[Gambit on Geonosis]]," Ackbar appeared during C-3PO's story of how the Rebel Alliance blew up the second Death Star. Ackbar gave a briefing on how to destroy the space station to the Rebels. In Lando Calrissian's story, Ackbar celebrated the destruction of the second Death Star by crossing out both Death Stars created by the Empire on a chalkboard.<ref name="Gambit on Geonosis">{{DroidTales|Gambit on Geonosis}}</ref>

====''LEGO Star Wars: The Resistance Rises''====
[[File:AckbarHoliday.png|thumb|left|275px|Ackbar gifts Calrissian with a new cape in ''The LEGO Star Wars Holiday Special''.]]
In the ''[[LEGO Star Wars: The Resistance Rises]]'' episode "[[Poe to the Rescue]]," Admiral Ackbar is held captive by the First Order. Poe Dameron and C-3PO snuck aboard the ''[[Subjugator]]'' to rescue him. After their escape, they went to an asteroid field where Ackbar's ship the ''Daisy Mae'' was hiding.<ref name="Poe to the Rescue">{{ResistanceRises|Poe to the Rescue}}</ref>

====''The LEGO Star Wars Holiday Special''====
During the [[Life Day]] celebration aboard the ''Millennium Falcon'' in ''[[The LEGO Star Wars Holiday Special]]'', Ackbar gave Lando Calrissian a present for Life Day. Calrissian, hoping that it was a [[cape]], opened the gift, to which Ackbar exclaimed, "It's a wrap!"<ref name="The LEGO Star Wars Holiday Special">''[[The LEGO Star Wars Holiday Special]]''</ref>
